body.name: predictable complement-symmetric soft rerandomization
body.construction: At block \(b\), draw \(x_b\in\mathcal X_G\) with \(P_{\mathrm{RR},b}(x\mid\mathcal F_{b-1})=P_0(x)f_{\eta,\kappa}\{W_b(x)\}/C_b\); set \(Q_{gb}=q_H\) for \(x_{gb}=1\) and \(q_L\) otherwise; then draw exactly \(nQ_{gb}\) treated units uniformly and independently within each group and hold both stages fixed for the two periods.
